parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: The name of the stream that contains the watermark.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The watermark template ID. You can call the [DescribeLiveStreamWatermarks](~~2848102~~) operation to obtain available watermark template IDs.

>  The TemplateId parameter is used to replace the watermark template ID during live streaming.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live dynamic-update-water-mark-stream-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain pull.aliyundoc.com --app liveApp0000 --stream liveStream0000 --template-id 749b7594-86d6-37b1-513b-e1e198450000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DynamicUpdateWaterMarkStreamRule --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --Stream liveStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'pull.aliyundoc.com' --TemplateId '749b7594-86d6-37b1-513b-e1e198450000'
